snapshot_sql: SELECT id, JSON_OBJECT('application_id', application_id, 'device_id', device_id, 'session_id', session_id, 'frame_counter', frame_counter, 'fport', fport, 'received_at', ttn_received_at, 'values', JSON_EXTRACT(decoded_payload, '$'), 'stored', TRUE) AS message FROM ttn_uplinks WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM ttn_uplinks ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200) recent) OR id IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY application_id, device_id, fport ORDER BY ttn_received_at DESC, frame_counter DESC, id DESC) AS position FROM ttn_uplinks) ranked WHERE position = 1) OR ttn_received_at >= CONCAT(LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) - INTERVAL 12 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f'), 23), 'Z') ORDER BY id
